texts.Route124_Text_SpencerIntro: Hey, are you lost at sea?\pIf you can beat my POKéMON,\nI can serve as your pilot.$
texts.Route124_Text_SpencerDefeat: I lost my bearings in battle!$
texts.Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle: Many people lose their bearings at sea.\pIf you're that sort, you should refer\nto the POKéNAV's MAP.$

texts.Route124_Text_RolandIntro: Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead\nof swimming yourself…\pI am envious!$
texts.Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle: I'm getting chilled…\nI've been in the water too long…\pI wish I could ride a POKéMON like you…$

texts.Route124_Text_JennyIntro: If you just float in the sea like\nthis, POKéMON come around to play.$
texts.Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle: While swimming, I noticed that some\nPOKéMON attack, and some just watch.\pI guess POKéMON have personalities\nof their own.$

texts.Route124_Text_GraceIntro: I'm growing bored of swimming…\nHow about a battle?$
texts.Route124_Text_GraceDefeat: I had no idea that you were\nthis strong!$
texts.Route124_Text_GracePostBattle: All the effort you put in must have\nmade you this strong.$

texts.Route124_Text_ChadIntro: Fufufufu… I dive deep underwater\nto go deep under cover.\lPlumbing the depths is where I excel!$
texts.Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle: I have it on good authority that\nthere's a DIVE spot around here.\pIt gives me the urge to go deep\nagain…$

texts.Route124_Text_LilaIntro: LILA: Sigh…\pHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\pLet's battle so I won't have to dwell\non that!$
texts.Route124_Text_LilaDefeat: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost!\nYou're in for it later!$
texts.Route124_Text_LilaNotEnoughMons: LILA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have two POKéMON.$
texts.Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle: LILA: Sigh…\pIf only it wasn't my little brother\nnext to me, but a nice boyfriend…$

texts.Route124_Text_RoyIntro: ROY: My big sister is tough at POKéMON!\pDon't cry when you lose!$
texts.Route124_Text_RoyDefeat: ROY: Uh-oh…\nMy big sister will chew me out…$
texts.Route124_Text_RoyNotEnoughMons: ROY: Did you want to battle us?\nBring two POKéMON, then.$
texts.Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle: ROY: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\pThat's why she doesn't have a\nboyfriend.$

texts.Route124_Text_DeclanIntro: Here I am swimming by my lonesome\non this wide, beautiful sea.\pThere's no other word for it.\nThis is pathetic!$
texts.Route124_Text_DeclanDefeat: I'm feeling blue.\nBlue as the sky…$
texts.Route124_Text_DeclanPostBattle: I should chat up lady SWIMMERS\nand invite them on a long swim.$

texts.Route124_Text_IsabellaIntro: I'm not going to lose to some\nsurfer TRAINER.$
texts.Route124_Text_IsabellaDefeat: I've only got sweat in my eyes!\nI am not crying!$
texts.Route124_Text_IsabellaPostBattle: You can find pretty colored shards\nof things around here.$
